app.title: ETH-68: Ethernet Audio Interface for Linux
app.author: chabad360
app.description: A hardware project that implements an Ethernet audio interface for Linux, providing low-latency audio routing over network.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and build the kernel module with make.
Load module on a Linux system and verify it appears under /proc/asound.
Run a simple test harness that sends audio over the interface and measures latency.
Compare throughput to a local ALSA loopback.
Verify compatibility with common audio tools (pavucontrol).
